sql: select captured_at::text, yes_bid, yes_ask, no_bid, no_ask, last_price, (select quantity || chr(32) || coalesce(side,'') || chr(32) || coalesce(market_exposure::text,'') from positions where market_ticker='KXMILLERLITEPOS-26NOV03-T84' order by captured_at desc limit 1) pos from market_snapshots where market_ticker='KXMILLERLITEPOS-26NOV03-T84' order by captured_at desc limit 3
